"""Initialize only the dedicated new public tmpfs after each host boot."""
import os
from pathlib import Path
import pwd
import subprocess

root=Path('/var/lib/maler_public_r2')
kind=subprocess.check_output(['findmnt','-n','-o','FSTYPE','-T',str(root)]).decode().strip()
assert os.geteuid()==0 and kind=='tmpfs' and root.resolve()==root
for name,account in [('tasks','liqiang'),('django_tmp','liqiang'),('work_tmp','liqiang'),('state','liqiang'),('nginx_tmp','nginx')]:
    target=root/name
    assert not target.is_symlink() and target.parent==root
    target.mkdir(mode=0o700,exist_ok=True)
    user=pwd.getpwnam(account)
    os.chown(str(target),user.pw_uid,user.pw_gid);os.chmod(str(target),0o700)
log=Path('/var/log/maler_public_cleanup')
assert not log.is_symlink()
log.mkdir(mode=0o700,exist_ok=True)
user=pwd.getpwnam('liqiang')
os.chown(str(log),user.pw_uid,user.pw_gid);os.chmod(str(log),0o700)
print('Dedicated public volatile task, upload-buffer and state directories ready.')

"""Scheduled cleanup of the new public tmpfs only; logs contain counts only."""
import datetime
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import time

root=Path('/var/lib/maler_public_r2')
assert Path(os.environ['MALER_TASK_ROOT']).resolve()==root/'tasks'
assert subprocess.check_output(['findmnt','-n','-o','FSTYPE','-T',str(root)]).decode().strip()=='tmpfs'
os.umask(0o077)
process=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'manage.py','cleanup_maler_cache','--apply'],stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,timeout=90)
text=process.stdout.decode('utf-8',errors='replace').strip()
deadline=time.time()-float(os.environ.get('MALER_CACHE_RETENTION_HOURS','24'))*3600
temporary_deleted=0
for name in ('django_tmp','work_tmp'):
    folder=root/name
    assert folder.resolve()==folder and not folder.is_symlink()
    for item in folder.iterdir():
        if item.is_symlink() or item.lstat().st_mtime>=deadline:
            continue
        assert item.resolve().parent==folder
        if item.is_dir():shutil.rmtree(str(item))
        else:item.unlink()
        temporary_deleted+=1
record={'server_utc':datetime.datetime.utcnow().isoformat()+'Z','exit_code':process.returncode,
        'task_cleanup_summary':text,'expired_temporary_entries_deleted':temporary_deleted,
        'scope':'New public volatile task and upload/work buffers only; no NAS or backup traversal'}
log=Path('/var/log/maler_public_cleanup')
with (log/'runs.jsonl').open('a',encoding='utf-8') as output:output.write(json.dumps(record)+'\n')
temp=log/'health.tmp';temp.write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8');temp.replace(log/'health.json')
print(json.dumps(record))
sys.exit(process.returncode)
